about.label: About the project
about.headline: A community archive of drinks, and the [moments] that come with them.
columns: Sip & Tell is a microsite about the drinks we reach for, and the people, places and feelings that come along with them. Every drink on the menu has a recipe, an illustration and an archive of short stories left by the people who’ve had it.

Instead of star ratings, each story is built from four questions: when you reach for the drink, what it tastes like, who’s at the table, and what actually happened. Together they read like a small portrait of someone’s experience.

steps.text: Answer four quick questions to add your own memories to the archive.

about.quote: Sometimes the drink isn’t really the point. It’s [the moments surrounding it] that stay in our memory.
